item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:45 HKT 21/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon, it will be very cold over Guangdong today. The cold weather will persist until midweek this week. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring rainy weather to southern China. With the upper-air disturbances departing and the monsoon moderating gradually, the weather will improve with temperatures rising progressively over the region in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 21/02 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: It will be very cold. Cloudy to overcast with rain. Rain will be more frequent at times.
Temp range: 7 - 9 C
R.H. range: 85 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
